newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Casablanca bourse appoints new managing director.
newsitem.headline: Casablanca bourse appoints new managing director.

text.p: Morocco has chosen a new managing director for the Casablanca stock exchange to replace the outgoing Abderrazak Laraki, a bourse official said on Friday.
"The bourse's board of directors is expected to meet next week to appoint officially Driss Bencheikh as new managing director," the official said.
The authoritative L'Economiste weekly newspaper reported that Bencheikh, who is in his early 30s, was an employee at Maroc Inter Titres stockbrokers and was already at work at the bourse.

"The appointment of Bencheikh coincides with the bourse reforms including the institution of a central depository and the installation of an electronic trading system which would guarantee more transparency of the business on the market," a market analyst said.
The bourse is expected to move its headquarters to a modern building located in the city centre in December, officials said.

Established in 1929, the Casablanca bourse has 47 listed stocks, including eight banks. The average monthly trading volume from January to October this year was 500 million dirhams and 1.2 million shares. ($1=8.6 dirhams)
